headline_quotes.quote: Trump endorses Netanyahu in Israeli election

emphasis.text: Quotes Trump saying the US demands this kind of partner of Israel, a country for which it has done much.

summary.text: US President Trump endorsed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's reelection in a social media post, nine days before Israel's 27 October election. He called Netanyahu a "Great Warrior" and a partner, while Netanyahu faces a tough re-election bid in the first national vote since Hamas attacked Israel on 7 October 2023.
